steps.journalDescription: Chief Tabor has said one of the branded has been killed for pilfering something from the Director's household. It's our job to search the body pile for what was stolen. I should enter the body pile via a ladder on the west side of the northwestern quarter of the camp.
I have entered the body pile. Now I just have to find the correct body.
I found the thief's body. I should head back up the ladder to the camp.
I found the thief's ring for Chief Tabor.
